name: a second commit of an acked op folds as remote (dedup evicted between resend and original)
about: Opus m1. L1's first send is lost in transit; at the deadline history has no entry, so the identical request is resent and commits (rev 1). The dedup entry is then evicted and the ORIGINAL arrives late: it commits again (rev 2). Every ack leaves rev at or past the op's commit, so the rev-2 echo carrying L1's op id is a second commit, not a duplicate: it must fold as a remote edit (view == server) with a notice — never be skipped into silent divergence.
